item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong direct evidence on courtroom truthfulness in 2024; the record is mostly about public statements, parliament, and responses to allegations.","evidence":[{"title":"Ethiopia’s leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/","summary":"Abiy told lawmakers Ethiopia had no intention of going to war with Somalia and framed peace as mutually beneficial; that is one of the clearest 2024 examples of straightforward public de-escalation.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia Has No Intention of Harming Somalia in Any Way: PM Abiy","publisher":"ENA English","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_3975603","summary":"Official transcript says Abiy denied harmful intent toward Somalia, said sea access should be handled as mutual benefit, and pointed to Somali troop training as evidence against conflict intent.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia’s leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-06","url":"https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/","summary":"AP reported Abiy also reassured Egypt on the Nile dam, which supports a limited reading of him trying to cool a live regional crisis rather than inflame it.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board Approves Four-Year US$3.4 billion Extended Credit Facility Arrangement for Ethiopia","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-29","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24291-ethiopia-imf-exec-board-approves-4yr-us3b-ecf-arr","summary":"Abiy told parliament IMF negotiations were in the final stage; the IMF approved the program three weeks later, which is at least consistent with a truthful status update on that issue.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia rejects allegations its forces massacred civilians as the West urges an investigation","publisher":"Associated Press","date":"2024-02-15","url":"https://toronto.citynews.ca/2024/02/15/ethiopia-rejects-allegations-its-forces-massacred-civilians-as-the-west-urges-an-investigation/","summary":"Ethiopian officials denied Merawi massacre allegations while independent monitors said at least 45 civilians were killed; this is strong evidence of denial in the face of serious contrary reporting.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Authorities Suspend Three Rights Groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups","summary":"HRW said Abiy publicly praised reforms like media freedom and NGO registration while the government kept cracking down on rights groups, suggesting a gap between rhetoric and actual conduct.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Halt Crackdown Against Human Rights Groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-06-18","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/06/18/ethiopia-halt-crackdown-against-human-rights-groups","summary":"Rights groups reported security and intelligence personnel followed and intimidated human-rights workers; that undercuts any claim that the government was being candid about its treatment of watchdogs.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: A secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels","publisher":"Reuters via EHRC","date":"2024-02-27","url":"https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/","summary":"Reuters, via the EHRC, reported a secret “Koree Nageenyaa” committee interfering in justice and linked to widespread violations, which implies opaque coercive governance rather than transparent truth-telling to courts or the public.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopian leader’s speech did not include ‘stern warning’ to Somalia and Egypt","publisher":"AFP Fact Check","date":"2024-09-04","url":"https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.36FG9HB","summary":"AFP showed a viral clip alleging a 2024 threat to Somalia and Egypt was actually old Tigray footage; this does not prove Abiy lied, but it shows how his speeches were used in ways that detached them from context.","question_ids":["7B.1"]},{"title":"Ethiopian leader’s remarks about alleged coup plotters taken out of context","publisher":"AFP Fact Check","date":"2024-07-09","url":"https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.363E7V8","summary":"AFP said a viral clip overstated Abiy’s July 4 parliamentary remarks about coup plotters; he warned dissidents abroad, but did not say a coup had been thwarted.","question_ids":["7B.1"]}]}
